<tjsPC>
<tjsInfo:
The main character of this story, Jack is
a magic-blooded human and a resident of
the town of Klungleton, located in the
world of Acrydia, an enchanted planet
that is one of the ten magic worlds.
Jack was lucky to be born with enchanted
blood that has multiple special
qualities, making him good at nearly
everything he tried while growing up,
with the potential to excel at almost any
career.  Given that the story revolves
around him, he is always included in the
party, and always the leader and
decision-maker who also does all the
talking with NPCs, no matter what order
the party members stand in.
>
<tjsInfo2:
With high ability scores in nearly
everything, Jack is a very rare type of
person who would be good at having
nearly any character class, and do
rather well at it, no matter what it is.
>

name: Derrick
note:
<tjsTraitsToHitPhysical:[190,109]>
<tjsTraitsToHitMagical:[150,109]>
<tjsTraitsMagicFocus:[5,119]>
<tjsTraitsMagicFocusDebuff:82>
<tjsTraitsMaxTacticalPoints:[225,115]>
<tjsTraitsCriticalHitRate:[9,8]>
<tjsTraitsCriticalEvadeRate:[2,9]>
<tjsActionsPerTurnByLevel:[0]>
<tjsActionsPerTurnBonus:[0]>
<tjsPC>
<tjsInfo:
Growing up as a wannabe special-forces
soldier, Derrick never ended up joining
the military, but as a young kid in
Klungleton he would dress up, wearing a
black beret hat and a military
special-forces mask.  Getting a bit older
and getting into high school, as well as
after school and into adulthood, Derrick
still had a fascination with a military
he was never a part of, and never grew
out of it.  On the other hand, he
developed some very real fighting skills,
and was always a good shot, not often
missing targets in fighting and sparring.
>
<tjsInfo2:
Though fairly well-rounded like most
humans are, Derrick is very good at
aiming weapons and spells of all kinds,
and has above-average Health Points and
physical defense scores.  He also has a
lot of Tactical Points which he can
regain rather fast.  With his skills to
aim well, he would make a good rifleman
or spellcaster.  His physical strength
and physical attack scores are below
average, so he would not be a good
warrior who fights with a sword, axe, or
melee weapon of any kind.
>

<tjsInfo:
Longsword grew up wanting to make his
given name mean something, so he studied
swords and swordfighting extensively,
gaining skills that made him better with
both Asian and western swords, both
one and two-handed.  At least some of
these skills he hasn't forgotten beyond
childhood, regardless of career.\\LB
    On the other hand, Longsword never
got the hang of axes of any kind, or
any type of firearm.  For whatever reason
if one puts a gun in his hands, he can't
seem to do much damage to a target with
it.  This is far worse than most of the
magic folk clan people, which as a
species are already inept and incapable
with guns and grenades compared to other
species of people of the Ten Worlds.\\LB
    Longsword is coincidentally good with
various magics, which he also studied
growing up, including arcane and clan
magic.  He has zero potential with holy
magic that clerics use, and only so much
with nature magic.  Longsword is
especially good with spells that involve
elemental metal, darkness, and acid.  He
can also be good with ninja magic, and
last but not least grew up with a good
potential for multiple styles of martial
arts.
>
<tjsInfo2:
Longsword would easily make a good
swordmaster, samurai, ninja, or even a
martial artist, yet could also make an
above-average wizard or combat mage.  He
can equip single-handed swords, both
western as well as Asian, no matter what
his character class is.  If he grows up
to be a swordfighter, he can use clan
magic to add to his abilities on the
battlefield quite effectively.  He would
never be the best axemaster, and would
make a terrible excuse for a cleric.\\LB
    Longsword is also very fearless,
known to shrug off even magical fear
from opponents.  He is also very
physically able for one of his species,
and magically gifted with a lot of
resistances to many effects.\\LB
    Longsword is one of a few
adventurers that is very quick and fast
in a fight, enough to have a chance to
make a free automatic counterattack when
an enemy attacks him with a non-ranged
attack.
>
